A Mediaplex Master Client Tag (MCT) is a container tag that has the added ability to trigger one or more site tracking pixels based on current conversion data. MCT functionality enables MOJO users to manage multiple third-party tracking tags from one location within the MOJO interface. Mediaplex only requires advertisers and agencies to place one ROI tag per conversion page, from which additional site conversion tags can piggy-back to track conversions as well.
Note: In order for the Master Client Tag (MCT) to correlate a conversion and activate the specific site conversion tag, the entire campaign must be trafficked through MOJO Adserver. MCT cannot correlate conversions for placements that were not set up and trafficked through MOJO Adserver.
Please contact Mediaplex Customer Support at 866-417-1271 to get started.

__mpr.tagDesc:
Return on Investment (ROI) Tag enables you to determine the monetary return on your initial advertising investment. Advertisers often identify one or more actions on a Web site as a key indicator of campaign success. MOJO reports refer to this advertiser-side action which results from an impression or a click as a conversion. Typically, conversion events include customers registering for a newsletter, making purchases or orders, downloading files, etc. Weighing the number of conversions against the cost of the media placements enables advertisers to determine the ROI of the various campaign components.
MOJO Adserver tracks both Click-thru conversions and View-thru conversions.
  1. Click-thru conversion: a user clicks an advertisement or text link and generates a conversion on the advertiserâs site.
  2. View-through conversion: a user views an advertisement, does not click on it, but visits the client site independently and generates a conversion.
A conversion is defined as a completed action on the part of the user such as a purchase or registration. Conversions are also sometimes referred to as Actions or Acquisitions.
To get started, please contact Mediaplex Customer Support at 866-417-1271.
